outcome: The FileBackedCockpitBridge now binds a post-relaunch completion world to the exited registered game's --world value before freezing any saved-world snapshot or launching a successor. A mismatched completion leaves reentry closed, preserves the original finish receipt, writes no handoff snapshot and grants no replacement authority.
summary: The prior bridge verified that completion.world_name was nonempty, but its post-relaunch handoff derived the world independently from game-process.json. A stale or wrong completion could therefore declare reentry ready. The handoff gate now compares the exact values before source-copy work. The focused production-path test supplies OtherWorld against the bound McWilliams owner and verifies reentry_failed, closed admission, generation zero, original controller retention, immutable receipt and no successor snapshot.
material_changes: Require native_save_completion.completion.world_name to equal the bound registered owner --world before FileBackedCockpitBridge freezes a post-relaunch saved-world handoff.
Add a full bridge/reentry regression for a mismatched completion world; it drives run.finish through the FIFO and verifies closed admission, unchanged receipt and absent successor handoff.
